SELECT
  MAX(subq_9.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_9.selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  , MAX(subq_16.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end) AS selling_store_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_9
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_16
